title: Canary signal calibrator with hierarchical SLO profiles
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Build a reusable 'signal calibrator' service that synthesizes multi-metric rollout signals (latency, error rate, token cost, throughput) into a single decision score and recommends adaptive rollback thresholds per customer cohort and deployment profile. This component will be pluggable into existing canary/A-B/shadow pipelines and power automatic rollback triggers and advisory thresholds in the Console. The calibrator must support hierarchical SLO profiles (global -> product -> customer), dynamic windowing, traffic-aware hysteresis, and cost-normalized scoring so we avoid noisy aborts during traffic spikes or expensive token bursts.
acceptance_criteria: Signal calibrator produces a single rollback score between 0-1 from multi-metric inputs with configurable weights
Console displays recommended threshold and confidence band for a selected cohort and deployment (canary/A-B/shadow)
Auto-rollback webhook triggers when score exceeds threshold and passes secondary debounce checks in >=3 production replay simulations
Calibration API supports per-customer overrides and inherits from hierarchical SLO profile when overrides absent
Baseline simulations show <=5% false-positive rollback rate on historical canaries (last 120 days) and <10% impact on availability for true-positive rollbacks
steps: Draft PRD with prioritized metrics and scoring equation variants (additive z-score, percentile fusion, Bayesian posterior fusion)
Prototype offline simulator that replays 90/120-day canary traces to evaluate candidate scorers and hysteresis windows
Define hierarchical SLO profile schema and Console UI surface for threshold recommendations and manual override
Implement lightweight calibration service (Go) with a scoring pipeline and REST API; add feature flag for gradual rollout
Instrument telemetry: per-customer score time-series, decision audits, and synthetic-probe coupling for false-positive analysis
Integrate auto-rollback webhook into the rollout controller with safety debounce (cohort quorum + synthetic confirmations)
Run phased experiments: shadow-mode scoring for 2 weeks, advisory-mode for 1 week, then enable auto-rollback for low-risk cohorts
